desc:
New tokio hotel obby!

Welcome to Tokio Hotel Obby!

Jump, survive and explore a chaotic obby inspired by the world and aesthetic of Tokio Hotel. Complete different stages filled with platforms, checkpoints and surprises as you progress through the game.

Call your friends and try to reach the end of the obby without falling!

This game is constantly growing, with new stages and updates added every week.

Updates:
We will keep adding new levels, areas and surprises regularly.
Like and favorite the game to stay updated!

Thanks for playing Tokio Hotel Obby!
